scope: release dependency and distribution license policy

findings.statement: The VinQut fat-JAR NOTICE identifies bundled Pilot software as LGPL-3.0-or-later, while the pinned Pilot checkout declares EPL-2.0. The redistributed class set and corresponding obligations require legal/source provenance reconciliation.

blockers.statement: The repository owner has not declared a product license; public distribution is prohibited.
